recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Any future change to the attribute/property split or the current allowed-type set should come from a newer work-group decision rather than from reopening FHIR-28284.
issue_request: FHIR-28284 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested replacing ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn and product modelling based on property/system/value/display with a value[x] choice model. Jira comments tied the request to ConceptMap $translate product output behavior.
initial_application: The R5 ConceptMap history applied the seed change: fd2a87c248 changed dependsOn.value to dependsOn.value[x] with choice types, and 8f39fd413c removed ConceptMap.group.element.target.dependsOn.display for FHIR-28284. Earlier March 2021 operation-definition work also added product and dependsOn output parts for $translate.
additional_context: FHIR-30515 and FHIR-34120 aligned $translate output and input parameters with the FHIR-28284 value model, and FHIR-33032 added id support. Later published ConceptMap decisions FHIR-39151, FHIR-40504, and FHIR-40636 separated mapping properties from source/target additional attributes, introduced the current attribute naming, and clarified valueCode handling. These later decisions account for differences from the literal 2021 resolution text.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. source/fhir.ini shows ConceptMap is active in the build; the current StructureDefinition defines dependsOn.attribute, dependsOn.value[x], dependsOn.valueSet, and product as a contentReference to the dependsOn backbone. The current $translate OperationDefinition exposes dependency, match.product, and match.dependsOn values using the same current allowed-type set.
